memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity (BMI 32 kg/m2).
She reports fatigue and mild dyspnoea on exertion, difficulty fitting into her driver’s uniform, and occasional bloating; she denies chest pain, joint pain, or fever. Examination shows BMI 32 kg/m2, waist circumference 102 cm, blood pressure 118/72 mmHg, pulse 78/min, lungs clear, heart regular, no edema. Smoking status: never smoked. Fasting lipid profile, glucose, HbA1c, liver enzymes and waist circumference are ordered today.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Orlistat 120 mg PO TID with each main meal.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: TC 5.2 mmol/L (<5.2), LDL 3.1 (<3.0), HDL 1.2 (>1.0), TG 1.8 (<1.7). Fasting glucose 5.6 mmol/L (3.9-5.5). HbA1c 5.8% (4.0-5.6). ALT 28 U/L (<35), AST 24 U/L (<34), ALP 78 U/L (40-129), GGT 22 U/L (<36). Waist circumference 102 cm.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity (BMI 31 kg/m2).
She notes reduced bloating and slightly easier uniform fit, but reports occasional oily spotting after meals. No new dyspnoea or fatigue. Exam: BMI 31, waist 98 cm, BP 116/70, pulse 76, lungs clear, CVS regular, no abdominal tenderness. Smoking status: never smoked. Orlistat tolerated; continue current dose.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Orlistat 120 mg PO TID with meals (continue).

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: TC 4.9 (<5.2), LDL 2.9 (<3.0), HDL 1.3 (>1.0), TG 1.5 (<1.7). Fasting glucose 5.4 (3.9-5.5). HbA1c 5.6% (4.0-5.6). ALT 26 (<35), AST 22 (<34), ALP 75 (40-129), GGT 20 (<36). Waist circumference 98 cm.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been having loose, oily stools and occasional abdominal cramping after taking orlistat. It’s affecting my work as I need to be on the road a lot. I’m wondering if we can stop it or try something else.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-10-15 at 10:00 AM with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity (BMI 30 kg/m2).
Patient reports cessation of orlistat due to GI side effects; weight stable over past month. No new symptoms. Exam: BMI 30, waist 95 cm, BP 118/72, pulse 78, lungs clear, CVS regular. Smoking status: never smoked. Advise lifestyle modification, dietitian referral, and consider re‑trying orlistat after symptom resolution.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Orlistat stopped. No new medication prescribed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity (BMI 30 kg/m2).
Patient reports adhering to reduced‑calorie diet and increased walking; weight unchanged. No GI complaints. Exam: BMI 30, waist 94 cm, BP 119/71, pulse 77, lungs clear, CVS regular. Smoking status: never smoked. Repeat metabolic panel to assess trends.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: TC 5.0 (<5.2), LDL 3.0 (<3.0), HDL 1.2 (>1.0), TG 1.6 (<1.7). Fasting glucose 5.5 (3.9-5.5). HbA1c 5.7% (4.0-5.6). ALT 27 (<35), AST 23 (<34), ALP 76 (40-129), GGT 21 (<36). Waist circumference 94 cm.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity (BMI 29 kg/m2).
Patient reports modest weight loss of 2 kg over past 8 months with continued diet and activity; feels more energetic. Exam: BMI 29, waist 90 cm, BP 117/70, pulse 76, lungs clear, CVS regular. Smoking status: never smoked. Labs within target ranges. Continue lifestyle plan; review in 4 months.
